notes:
Player Data works again on Valheim 1.0.

1.0 changed the character save format three times over (file v43 to v46) and the old reader walked straight off the end of it - that's the "EOF skipping N bytes" error, and why the Dashboard had nothing to show either. Stats are now grouped into blocks, biomes are stored by name, and an item no longer records its own name, just a hash of it. All of that is read properly now, and 1.0 inventories come back with real item names, quality and equipped state. Older characters still load exactly as before.

MegaLoad can be the same person on two computers. There was no way to sign in on a second machine if you didn't still have your link code: entering your own name just told you it was taken and stopped dead. That dead end now offers to link the machine instead, and the Worker keeps a separate key per device, so two computers no longer knock each other offline - which is what was quietly stopping MegaLists from syncing.

Sync failures are no longer silent. Every MegaList sync error used to be swallowed whole; a run of failures now says so.

New profiles start with no mods ticked. Creating a profile used to mean installing the whole Mega series by default - use Select All when that's what you want.
